why: 4 words — the recommended length
cmd: git commit -m "fixed cache policy ttl"

why: 6 words — exactly the hard max
cmd: git commit -m "added oauth metadata facade and bearer"

why: 7 words — one over the hard max
cmd: git commit -m "added oauth metadata facade and cognito bearer"

why: case is not checked — filenames keep theirs
cmd: git commit -m "documented mcp connector in CLAUDE.md"

why: a hyphenated word counts as one
cmd: git commit -m "clarified aperture-dev is test-only"

why: a second -m is a body, and here a trailer
cmd: git commit -m "fixed ttl" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>"

why: the harness's default heredoc style — body + trailer inside command substitution
cmd:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fixed ttl

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

why: a real newline inside one -m is a body
cmd:
git commit -m "fixed ttl

longer explanation here"

why: a message from a file can't be checked
cmd: git commit -F msg.txt

why: -qam cluster carries the message
cmd: git commit -qam "added a message that is clearly much too long"

why: --message= form
cmd: git commit --message="added a message that is clearly much too long"

why: message glued onto -m
cmd: git commit -m"added a message that is clearly much too long"

why: the SECOND commit in a chain breaks the rule
cmd: git commit -m "fixed ttl" && git add b.ts && git commit -m "added a message that is clearly much too long"

why: a compliant commit chained between other commands
cmd: cd /tmp && git add a.ts && git commit -q -m "fixed health check auth header" && git log --oneline -1

why: amend without a new message is never checked
cmd: git commit --amend --no-edit

why: WIP commits are exempt
cmd: git commit -m "WIP: saving work before the rebase in case anything breaks"

why: not a commit at all
cmd: git status

why: 'git commit' only inside another command's argument — no false block
cmd: git log --grep="git commit -m one two three four five six seven"

why: staged AWS key — the scan that was silently dead from a wrapped regex
cmd: git commit -m "added config"

why: clean staged diff passes the scan
cmd: git commit -m "added the answer"

why: a commit on a deploy branch is blocked before anything else
cmd: git commit -m "fixed ttl"
